dedupe_keys.name: replication data for calculating operational patterns for electric vehicle charging on a real distribution network based on renewables production

description: Replication Data for: Calculating operational patterns for electric vehicle charging on a real distribution network based on renewables’ production is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Stavros Lazarou, Vasiliki Vita (School of Pedagogical & Technological Education). The connection of electric vehicles to distribution network has been an emerging issue for power systems. On one hand, it provides new opportunities towards climate change mitigation, if electric energy used for charging is produced from zero emission sources. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. Formats: TXT. Size stated: 1466. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
